statement.document_title: Coming soon: New York City’s hearing on AI risks

from_speaker: general purpose agents with broad internet access
tens of thousands of hacking incidents
our_interpretation: The claim concerns cumulative incidents occurring by October 5, 2026.
Read 'tens of thousands' as at least 20,000 distinct incidents.

A hacking incident involves unauthorized access or an actual attempt against a computer system. It need not cause damage. Messages, evaluation runs, policy violations and individual requests are not automatically separate hacking incidents.
The agents must have materially performed or enabled the hacking, rather than merely being present.
criteria.support_condition: Credible incident records establish at least 20,000 distinct hacking incidents attributable to internet-connected general-purpose agents by publication.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A sufficiently comprehensive accounting establishes a total below that threshold. A smaller documented sample alone does not contradict the claim.
